stem.en: A student writes: "The greenhouse effect keeps Earth warm, so adding more carbon dioxide can only help." Which correction is right?

text.en: Some is needed, but added gases hold more heat

feedback.en: Yes. Without it Earth would be far colder, and more of it warms Earth further.

text.en: The greenhouse effect is harmful in every amount

feedback.en: No. Without it Earth's average would be about -18 °C.

text.en: Carbon dioxide does not hold any heat

feedback.en: No. It is a greenhouse gas.

text.en: Carbon dioxide is the largest part of the air

feedback.en: No. It is only about 0.04 per cent.

explanation.en: The natural greenhouse effect keeps Earth's average at about 15 °C. Human activities add more of these gases, so more heat is held in and the climate changes.

hints.en: Is the greenhouse effect bad in itself?
What happens when more gas is added?
